description: This file defines the RecycleBinClient class for interacting with the Amazon Recycle Bin service in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various operations related to rules and resource tags.

classes.description: Client class for interacting with the Amazon Recycle Bin service, extending the base AwsClient class with methods for managing recycle bin rules and tags.

methods.name: createRule
methods.description: Creates a new recycle bin rule.

methods.name: deleteRule
methods.description: Deletes a specified recycle bin rule.

methods.name: getRule
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specified recycle bin rule.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: updateRule
methods.description: Updates an existing recycle bin rule.
